summary: No contract mismatch. Server /ws is live; client targets /ws. The user-reported /stream-only endpoint in openapi.json was a stale observation — current pod exposes /healthz + /transcribe + /stream (POST SSE, deprecated) but NOT /ws as a separate HTTP route in OpenAPI because FastAPI does not include WebSocket routes in the OpenAPI schema by design. The WS endpoint is registered via @app.websocket('/ws') and confirmed separately via direct connection.
note_on_missing_ws_in_openapi: FastAPI intentionally omits WebSocket endpoints from /openapi.json. The absence of /ws from openapi.json does NOT mean /ws is absent from the server — it is always omitted for WS routes. The correct probe is a direct WS connect, not /openapi.json inspection.

server_routes_actual./stream: POST application/octet-stream — SSE streaming (deprecated, HTTP/1.1 buffering issue documented in server.py header)
server_routes_actual./ws: WebSocket — bidirectional streaming, registered via @app.websocket('/ws') at server.py:262

action_items.description: The /stream POST SSE endpoint in server.py is still registered and appears in openapi.json, which will confuse future validators into thinking it is the streaming path. Add a deprecation note or remove /stream entirely once /ws is confirmed stable in production.
action_items.risk: zero — /stream is not wired by the client at all

action_items.description: The parakeet_stt.py class docstring (line 112-116) says 'Defaults to streaming via POST /stream (SSE)' — this is stale copy from before the WS migration. The actual streaming path is /ws. Fix the docstring to avoid future confusion.
